inspection.type:
∀ {k t : ℕ} {C : QuarticQuery.Circuit (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)},
  1 ≤ k →
    1 ≤ t →
      QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C (QuarticQuery.P k t) →
        ∀ {n : ℕ},
          QuarticQuery.Forrelation.repetitions k (QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t) / ↑(40 * t)) ≤
              n →
            ∃ val,
              (QuarticQuery.Upper.Runs (QuarticQuery.Upper.budget k t n (Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.Upper.Tests t C)))
                  fun x b => QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (val x) b) ∧
                (∀
                    (x :
                      QuarticQuery.BitInput
                        (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))),
                    QuarticQuery.Fkm k t C x = Bool.false →
                      val x ≤
                        ↑(QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)) *
                          QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)) ∧
                  ∀
                    (x :
                      QuarticQuery.BitInput
                        (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))),
                    QuarticQuery.Fkm k t C x = Bool.true →
                      1 - val x ≤
                        2 * ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t) / 2 ^ QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval (QuarticQuery.mValue t) +
                            ↑(QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)) *
                              QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t) +
                          QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)

lean.note: States the zero-input and one-input error inequalities for one fixed physical program. Strict <1/3 numeric bound is a separate declaration.
premises: k,t ≥ 1; realizing circuit; enough decoder repetitions.

lean.note: At m>=2 the chosen parameters give T epsilon=1/1000 and the full one-input error strictly below 1/3.

adjudication_findings.claim: Error and query budget: 2m/2^T<=1/500, T eps=1/1000, eps<=1/11000; tournament O_k(sqrt m x^3 (log x)^2), verifications O_k(sqrt m x^(7/2) log x).
adjudication_findings.reason: Recomputed: largest total error over m=4..4^199 is 0.00304; T>=11. Cost: c=O_k(x log x), sqrt K=O_k(sqrt m x^(3/2)), each call x, at most T verifications. So Q=O_k(sqrt m (log m)^4): b_k may be the absolute value 4 (r1 proof_audit line 215).

presentation.body: On a zero-input, the error probability is at most $T\epsilon$. On a one-input, it is at most $2m/2^T+T\epsilon+\epsilon<1/3$.
presentation.body_plain: On a zero-input, the error probability is at most Tε. On a one-input, it is at most 2m/2ᵀ + Tε + ε < 1/3.
